# ChurchCast

> Real-time, AI-powered multilingual translation for church services. Broadcasters speak; every listener hears the sermon translated into their language on their phone — no app, no login.

ChurchCast captures live audio from the pulpit, transcribes it, translates it into every language the congregation needs, and streams synthesized speech plus scrolling captions to each listener's phone via a shared QR code or link.
